title: 12 Iconic Stops: Banff & Yoho Premium Small Group Guided Tour
blurb:
Experience the best of the Canadian Rockies on this shared small-group tour, visiting 12 of Banff’s most iconic locations, including Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, Lake Minnewanka, Johnston Canyon (Lower Falls) or Marble Canyon, Castle Mountain Lookout, Morant’s Curve, Lake Louise, Morinae lake, Peyto Lake, Bow Lake, Crowfoot Glacier, and Moraine Lake. In winter, Moraine Lake is replaced with Emerald Lake and the Natural Bridge.
Enjoy breathtaking glaciers, turquoise lakes, waterfalls, and sweeping mountain viewpoints, with plenty of time for photos, short walks, and exploration.

Perfect for travellers looking for a comfortable, well-organized small-group experience showcasing the very best of Banff National Park and the Canadian Rockies.
